raw_response:
Answer: D
Reason: The patient is immunocompromised (renal transplant) and presents with unilateral widespread confluent consolidation progressing to cavitation with an air crescent sign, which are hallmark radiographic features of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis. ABPA typically presents with fleeting opacities and central bronchiectasis, while semi-invasive disease is more chronic and less likely to show such rapid, extensive consolidation in this context.
